# Phase 2: Architecture

1. Read approved requirements and unresolved decisions.
2. Design within the repository's Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, H2, and Maven conventions.
3. Keep controllers thin, business rules in services, and include persistence, API errors, and documentation sync.
4. Use [the architecture template](../../templates/architecture-template.md) for `architecture.md`.
5. Identify tradeoffs, risks, security assumptions, and open questions; do not represent assumptions as decisions.
6. Report the artifact and wait at the phase approval gate.

The phase agent is `.github/agents/sdlc-step-02-architecture.agent.md`.
